tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace. Returns numbered lines.

offset.description: 1-based first line to read.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List the files under a workspace directory, recursively up to a small depth.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Case-insensitive plain-substring search across workspace text files.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory to search, default the root.

tools.name: propose_edit
tools.description: Propose a replacement for a file and return a unified diff. Nothing is written to disk.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a file or replace its entire content. Parent directories are created.

content.description: The complete file content to write.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace an exact string in an existing file. Fails when the string is absent or ambiguous.

oldText.description: The exact text to replace, including indentation.

newText.description: Its replacement; empty deletes the text.

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match.

tools.name: delete_path
tools.description: Delete a file, or a directory when recursive is set.

recursive.description: Required to delete a non-empty directory.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a directory, including any missing parents.

tools.name: move_path
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory inside the workspace.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command with the workspace as its working directory. Returns the interleaved output and the exit code; a non-zero exit is reported, not thrown.

cwd.description: Workspace-relative working directory, default the root.

timeoutMs.description: Kill the command after this long, default 120000.

tools.name: write_todos
tools.description: Publish the current task list so the user can follow along.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch an https page and return its readable text and up to 40 source links. Follow relevant returned links instead of guessing endpoint paths. fetchedAt is the retrieval time, not the publication date or market-price timestamp; those must be verified from the source.

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Load the complete instructions for one available skill before following it.

tools.name: search_skill_resources
tools.description: Search resources from one skill already loaded with load_skill; never searches the whole catalog.

skillId.description: One skill already activated with load_skill.

tools.name: read_skill_resource
tools.description: Read one text resource or one Markdown section bundled with a loaded skill.

section.description: Exact Markdown heading, or null for the whole file.

offset.description: Character offset within the file or selected section.

maxChars.description: Requested chunk size, capped by the agent policy.

tools.name: read_tool_output
tools.description: Read or search the full output of an earlier tool call that was too large to show in full. Pass the locator from that result. Use pattern to find matching lines, or offset/limit to page through it.

locator.description: The locator printed with the shortened result.

offset.description: Character offset to start reading from.

pattern.description: Regular expression matched per line; returns matching lines with numbers.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory to search, default the root.

tools.name: propose_edit
tools.description: Propose a replacement for a file and return a unified diff. Nothing is written to disk.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a file or replace its entire content. Parent directories are created.

content.description: The complete file content to write.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace an exact string in an existing file. Fails when the string is absent or ambiguous.

oldText.description: The exact text to replace, including indentation.

newText.description: Its replacement; empty deletes the text.

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match.

tools.name: delete_path
tools.description: Delete a file, or a directory when recursive is set.

recursive.description: Required to delete a non-empty directory.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a directory, including any missing parents.

tools.name: move_path
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory inside the workspace.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command with the workspace as its working directory. Returns the interleaved output and the exit code; a non-zero exit is reported, not thrown.

cwd.description: Workspace-relative working directory, default the root.

timeoutMs.description: Kill the command after this long, default 120000.

tools.name: write_todos
tools.description: Publish the current task list so the user can follow along.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch an https page and return its readable text and up to 40 source links. Follow relevant returned links instead of guessing endpoint paths. fetchedAt is the retrieval time, not the publication date or market-price timestamp; those must be verified from the source.

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Load the complete instructions for one available skill before following it.

tools.name: search_skill_resources
tools.description: Search resources from one skill already loaded with load_skill; never searches the whole catalog.

skillId.description: One skill already activated with load_skill.

tools.name: read_skill_resource
tools.description: Read one text resource or one Markdown section bundled with a loaded skill.

section.description: Exact Markdown heading, or null for the whole file.

offset.description: Character offset within the file or selected section.

maxChars.description: Requested chunk size, capped by the agent policy.

tools.name: read_tool_output
tools.description: Read or search the full output of an earlier tool call that was too large to show in full. Pass the locator from that result. Use pattern to find matching lines, or offset/limit to page through it.

locator.description: The locator printed with the shortened result.

offset.description: Character offset to start reading from.

pattern.description: Regular expression matched per line; returns matching lines with numbers.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a UTF-8 text file from the workspace. Returns numbered lines.

offset.description: 1-based first line to read.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List the files under a workspace directory, recursively up to a small depth.

tools.name: search_files
tools.description: Case-insensitive plain-substring search across workspace text files.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory to search, default the root.

tools.name: propose_edit
tools.description: Propose a replacement for a file and return a unified diff. Nothing is written to disk.

tools.name: write_file
tools.description: Create a file or replace its entire content. Parent directories are created.

content.description: The complete file content to write.

tools.name: edit_file
tools.description: Replace an exact string in an existing file. Fails when the string is absent or ambiguous.

oldText.description: The exact text to replace, including indentation.

newText.description: Its replacement; empty deletes the text.

replaceAll.description: Replace every occurrence instead of requiring a unique match.

tools.name: delete_path
tools.description: Delete a file, or a directory when recursive is set.

recursive.description: Required to delete a non-empty directory.

tools.name: create_directory
tools.description: Create a directory, including any missing parents.

tools.name: move_path
tools.description: Move or rename a file or directory inside the workspace.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run a shell command with the workspace as its working directory. Returns the interleaved output and the exit code; a non-zero exit is reported, not thrown.

cwd.description: Workspace-relative working directory, default the root.

timeoutMs.description: Kill the command after this long, default 120000.

tools.name: write_todos
tools.description: Publish the current task list so the user can follow along.

tools.name: fetch_url
tools.description: Fetch an https page and return its readable text and up to 40 source links. Follow relevant returned links instead of guessing endpoint paths. fetchedAt is the retrieval time, not the publication date or market-price timestamp; those must be verified from the source.

tools.name: load_skill
tools.description: Load the complete instructions for one available skill before following it.

tools.name: search_skill_resources
tools.description: Search resources from one skill already loaded with load_skill; never searches the whole catalog.

skillId.description: One skill already activated with load_skill.

tools.name: read_skill_resource
tools.description: Read one text resource or one Markdown section bundled with a loaded skill.

section.description: Exact Markdown heading, or null for the whole file.

offset.description: Character offset within the file or selected section.

maxChars.description: Requested chunk size, capped by the agent policy.

tools.name: read_tool_output
tools.description: Read or search the full output of an earlier tool call that was too large to show in full. Pass the locator from that result. Use pattern to find matching lines, or offset/limit to page through it.

locator.description: The locator printed with the shortened result.

offset.description: Character offset to start reading from.

pattern.description: Regular expression matched per line; returns matching lines with numbers.

offset.description: Character offset to start reading from.

pattern.description: Regular expression matched per line; returns matching lines with numbers.
